verdict.rationale: Bland is an AI phone-call platform, so DTMF, IVR navigation, and voicemail handling are fair questions to ask of it. The evidence pack covers pathways, SIP, batch calls, webhooks, and outbound dispatch. None of it mentions sending DTMF keypresses, navigating IVR menus, or detecting or leaving voicemail, so this applicable capability is unevidenced.
